chapter.heading: The Glories of the City of God A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A Song.
chapter.v:
His foundation
is in the holy mountains.

The Lord
loves the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.

Glorious things
are spoken of you, O city of God! Selah

“I will
make mention of Rahab and Babylon to those who know Me; Behold, O Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia:‘This one was born there.’ ”

And of
Zion it will be said,“This one and that one were born in her; And the Most High Himself shall establish her.”

The Lord
will record, When He registers the peoples:“This one was born there.”Selah

Both the
singers and the players on instruments say,“All my springs are in you.”
